newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins two casino contracts.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins two casino contracts.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Tuesday it received two contracts to provide its GameCash services at the Miss Marquette Riverboat Casino in Marquette, Iowa, and the Mole Lake Casinos & Bingo in Crandon, Wis.
The Mole Lake Casinos are owned and operated by the Sokaogan Chippewa Community and offer more than 500 slot positions. Miss Marquette offers nearly 700 slot positions.
Game Financial said its GameCash services will become operational at both properties in the first quarter of 1997.

Game Financial provides patrons of gaming establishments, such as casinos, with access to cash through credit card advances, check cashing and automated teller machines. The GameCash system is a credit card cash advance system.
